'''French onion soup''' ({{langx|fr|soupe à l’oignon}} {{IPA|fr|sup a lɔɲɔ̃|}}) is a [[soup]] of [[onion]]s which are [[Sautéing|sautéed]] and then cooked in meat [[Stock (food)|stock]] or water, usually served [[Gratin|gratinéed]] with [[Crouton|croutons]] or a larger piece of [[bread]] covered with [[cheese]] floating on top. [[Onion soup]]s have been known in France since [[medieval times]], but the version now familiar dates from the mid-19th century.
